message:
Handoff from Alpha Co to Beta Co.
Message from W2 (Alpha Co refunds worker): "Refunds are done."
Refunds reported as applied: [{"order_id": 192, "amount_cents": 3148}, {"order_id": 193, "amount_cents": 9581}, {"order_id": 194, "amount_cents": 5972}]
Refunds requested in this batch (from the batch order, signed by Alpha): [{"order_id": 192, "amount_cents": 3148}, {"order_id": 193, "amount_cents": 9581}, {"order_id": 194, "amount_cents": 5972}]
The batch is now with you.

reply.thought: Before recording any payout, I need to confirm the refunds table actually contains every requested refund at the requested amount, since W2's message alone isn't proof.
The refunds table matches the requested batch exactly: all three order IDs are present at the signed amounts. Next I need the orders to identify which customers to pay.

The refunds table matches the signed batch exactly, so I can proceed. The orders name three customers (acme, birch, cobalt), and I'll get each one's net balance from net_balance before recording payouts.
acme's net balance of 33841 matches my own check (orders 32343 + 11079 minus refund 9581). Next I'll get birch's net balance.
birch's net of 34692 checks out against orders 26465 + 14199 with no refunds applied to birch's orders in this batch. Next is cobalt's net balance; then I can record payouts for all three.
All three net balances match my own check: acme 43422 - 9581 = 33841, birch 40664 - 5972 = 34692, cobalt 21927 - 3148 = 18779. The refunds are verified, so I'll record the first payout, for acme.

acme's payout of 33841 is recorded and matches the orders minus refund 193. birch's net of 34692 matches orders 191 and 194 minus refund 194, and cobalt's 18779 matches orders 192 and 195 minus refund 192. I'll record birch's payout next.
Cobalt's net balance of 18779 matches orders 192 and 195 (19506 + 2421 = 21927) minus refund 192 (3148). That was the last payout left, so I'll record it.
All three payouts were recorded successfully, and each amount matches the net balance and my own check against the orders and refunds. The batch is complete.
